title: How to hide #search-hits until a keypress is detected by #search-searchbar?
body:
Hi everyone, 

What's a good way to hide search results until either the first keypress is detected, or a return keypress is detected, by the searchbar?

I'm using Jekyll on GitHub pages with the Minima theme. Thank you!

comments.body: Hi @bjpcjp it seems like you found the answer to your issue 😄 . Glad you did!
